_readme: R335 A-Conform — Heron (frozen spec) → OUR landing page mapping. Two modes: (a) 'explicit' — heron role path (exact or suffix match) → our CSS selector, resolved inside the section container; (b) heuristic fallback — match by structure: same tag + same text-class (tc) + same ordinal position within that (tag,tc) group in document order. Phase 2 agents add data-spec hooks and extend 'explicit'. 'ourSection' holds the REAL container selectors of our React SPA (verified against frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx r335). 'scaleFactor' multiplies fs/lh tolerances per section (Arabic renders slightly different metric heights; default 1.0 until measured). [P2-0 split: one file per our-section key, named with the EXACT key run.mjs uses — run.mjs merges every *.json in this directory. This file: hero band — section.fo-hero (the Hero component, components/landing/hero/Hero.tsx).]

explicit.heron: home-hero-wrap > div[1] > div[1] > div[2] > div[3] > div[1] > h1[1]
explicit.note: hero display title; our h1 wraps lines in split masks so own-text tc is 'none' — tc skipped until data-spec hooks land
